newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: RUGBY UNION-ROUX KICKS TRANSVAAL TO VICTORY.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-ROUX KICKS TRANSVAAL TO VICTORY.

text.p: Springbok scrum-half Johan Roux was the unlikely goalkicking hero as Transvaal opened their Super 12 campaign with a 24-20 victory over Free State on Sunday.
In an error-strewn game Roux took over the kicking from an out-of-sorts Gavin Johnson and slotted three penalties in the last 10 minutes to steal a win for the visitors.
Free State had looked the likely winners when they scored two tries in three minutes at the beginning of the second-half after turning around 10-6 in arrears.
Springbok flanker Andre Venter scored the first after bursting down the middle from a ruck and exchanging passes with right wing Christo Potgieter.

Transvaal's restart kick went dead and Free State scored from the subsequent scrum on the half-way line. Cheetah captain Helgard Muller made the running down the left and then kicked cleverly infield for left wing Stephen Brink to score.

Flyhalf M.J. Smith converted both and the home side were 20-10 ahead. But Transvaal fought back with a try by Johnson from a tap penalty five metres from the line to add to a seventh minute effort by lock Hannes Strydom and at 20-15 the visitors were back in the game.
Free State suffered all afternoon from poor handling under pressure and a rash of offside decisions gave Roux the chance to put his team ahead with penalties in the 70th, 72nd and 76th minutes.

Free State ran the ball desperately as injury-time extended to four minutes, but the Transvaal defence held firm to earn their side four points to Free State's one for finishing within seven points of their opponents.

Free State - Jorrie Kruger; Christo Potgieter, Helgard Muller (captain), Brendan Venter, Stephen Brink; M.J.Smith (Andre Fourie, 63rd), Werner Swanepoel; Jaco Coetzee, Johan Erasmus, Andre Venter, Braam Els, Ryno Oppermann (Charl van Rensburg, 66th) Dougie Heymans, Naka Drotske, Os du Randt.

Transvaal - Gavin Johnson; Jannie van der Walt, Japie Mulder, Christiaan Scholtz, Joe Gillingham; Hennie le Roux, Johan Roux; Andre Vos, Warren Brosnihan, Ian Macdonald (Bruce Thorne, 78th), Hannes Strydom, Kobus Wiese (captain), Willie Enslin (Kapstock van Greuning, 48th), Chris Rossouw, Balie Swart.
